ocaml:
(* 7701(b)(3)(A): substantial presence test - day counts in US, weighted by year *)
let meets_substantial_presence_test
    ~(days_present_current_year : int)
    ~(days_present_1st_preceding_year : int)
    ~(days_present_2nd_preceding_year : int) : bool =
  let weighted_day_sum =
    float_of_int days_present_current_year *. 1.0
    +. float_of_int days_present_1st_preceding_year /. 3.0
    +. float_of_int days_present_2nd_preceding_year /. 6.0
  in
  days_present_current_year >= 31 &&
  weighted_day_sum >= 183.0

ocaml:
(* 7701(b)(4)(A)(iv): conjunction of 31-consecutive-day test and 75%-testing-period test *)
let meets_31_day_and_75_percent_test
    ~(consecutive_days_present_in_election_year : int)
    ~(testing_period_length : int)
    ~(days_present_in_testing_period : int) : bool =
  let meets_31_consecutive_days =
    consecutive_days_present_in_election_year >= 31
  in
  let absent_days_in_testing_period =
    testing_period_length - days_present_in_testing_period
  in
  let excused_absence_days = min 5 absent_days_in_testing_period in
  let effective_days_present =
    days_present_in_testing_period + excused_absence_days
  in
  let meets_75_percent_of_testing_period =
    float_of_int effective_days_present
    >= 0.75 *. float_of_int testing_period_length
  in
  meets_31_consecutive_days && meets_75_percent_of_testing_period

(* 7701(b)(10)(A)-(B): applicability test for coordination with section 877 *)
let is_subject_to_877_coordination
    ~(initial_period_start_year : int)
    ~(initial_period_end_year : int)
    ~(resumed_residency_year : int) : bool =
  (* initial residency period must span at least 3 consecutive calendar years *)
  (initial_period_end_year - initial_period_start_year + 1 >= 3)
  &&
  (* individual ceased residency after initial period, then resumed before close of 3rd calendar year beginning after close of initial residency period *)
  resumed_residency_year > initial_period_end_year
  && resumed_residency_year <= initial_period_end_year + 3

(* 7701(b)(10): taxes gap period (after initial residency period, before resumed residency) under section 877(b) manner, only if that tax exceeds section 871 tax; returns None if inapplicable or if 877(b) tax does not exceed 871 tax *)
let applicable_gap_period_tax
    ~(initial_period_start_year : int)
    ~(initial_period_end_year : int)
    ~(resumed_residency_year : int)
    ~(individual_income : float) : float option =

(* 7701(b)(5)(E): special rules for teachers, trainees, and students — groups the teacher/trainee limitation (i) and the student limitation (ii) *)
module Teachers_trainees_students_limitation = struct
  (* 7701(b)(5)(E)(i): teacher/trainee barred from exempt status under (A)(ii) if exempt under (A)(ii) or (A)(iii) in >= threshold of the preceding 6 calendar years; threshold is 4 instead of 2 if all compensation is described in section 872(b)(3) *)
  let teacher_or_trainee_limited
      (exempt_years_under_ii_or_iii_in_preceding_six_years : int)
      (all_compensation_described_in_872b3 : bool)
      : bool =
    let threshold = if all_compensation_described_in_872b3 then 4 else 2 in
    exempt_years_under_ii_or_iii_in_preceding_six_years >= threshold

  (* 7701(b)(5)(E)(ii): student barred from exempt status under (A)(iii) for any calendar year after the 5th calendar year of exemption under (A)(ii) or (A)(iii), unless individual establishes no intent to permanently reside in the United States and meets requirements of (D)(ii) *)
  let student_limited
      (cumulative_exempt_years_under_ii_or_iii : int)
      (establishes_no_intent_to_permanently_reside : bool)
      (meets_requirements_of_subparagraph_d_ii : bool)
      : bool =
    cumulative_exempt_years_under_ii_or_iii > 5 &&
    not (establishes_no_intent_to_permanently_reside && meets_requirements_of_subparagraph_d_ii)
end

(* 7701(b)(7): presence in United States on a given day, subject to commuter/transit/crew exceptions *)
let is_present_in_united_states
    ~physically_present_at_any_time : bool
    ~is_regular_commuter_from_canada_or_mexico : bool
    ~is_in_transit_between_two_foreign_points : bool
    ~hours_present_in_transit : float
    ~is_regular_crew_member_of_foreign_vessel : bool
    ~engages_in_trade_or_business_on_such_day : bool
    () : bool =
  if is_regular_commuter_from_canada_or_mexico then
    (* 7701(b)(7)(B): commuters from Canada/Mexico not treated as present on commuting day *)
    false
  else if is_in_transit_between_two_foreign_points && hours_present_in_transit < 24.0 then
    (* 7701(b)(7)(C): transit between 2 foreign points, present less than 24 hours *)
    false
  else if is_regular_crew_member_of_foreign_vessel && not engages_in_trade_or_business_on_such_day then
    (* 7701(b)(7)(D): crew member of foreign vessel, unless also engaged in trade or business that day *)
    false
  else
    (* 7701(b)(7)(A): general rule - physically present at any time during the day *)
    physically_present_at_any_time

ocaml:
(* 7701(b)(3): substantial presence test overall - day counts (excluding (D) exempt/medical days) weighted per (A), subject to closer-connection exception (B) unless barred by (C) *)
let satisfies_substantial_presence_test
    (individual : person)
    ~(days_in_current_year : date list)
    ~(days_in_1st_preceding_year : date list)
    ~(days_in_2nd_preceding_year : date list)
    ~(has_foreign_tax_home : bool)
    ~(has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country : bool)
    ~(had_pending_adjustment_of_status_application : bool)
    ~(took_other_steps_to_apply_for_lawful_permanent_resident_status : bool)
    : bool =
  let count_included_days days =
    List.length (List.filter (fun day -> not (is_excluded_presence_day individual day)) days)
  in
  let days_present_current_year = count_included_days days_in_current_year in
  let days_present_1st_preceding_year = count_included_days days_in_1st_preceding_year in
  let days_present_2nd_preceding_year = count_included_days days_in_2nd_preceding_year in
  let passes_general_test =
    meets_substantial_presence_test
      ~days_present_current_year
      ~days_present_1st_preceding_year
      ~days_present_2nd_preceding_year
  in
  let exception_applies =
    closer_connection_exception_applies
      days_present_current_year
      has_foreign_tax_home
      has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country
    && not (bars_closer_connection_exception
              had_pending_adjustment_of_status_application
              took_other_steps_to_apply_for_lawful_permanent_resident_status)
  in
  passes_general_test && not exception_applies

(* 7701(b)(5): exempt individual for a day, applying (A) general definition subject to (E) limitations on teacher/trainee and student status *)
let is_exempt_individual_for_day
    ~(is_foreign_government_related_individual : bool)
    ~(is_teacher_or_trainee : bool)
    ~(is_student : bool)
    ~(is_professional_athlete : bool)
    ~(is_temporarily_in_united_states_to_compete : bool)
    ~(event_organized_primarily_to_benefit_501c3_exempt_org : bool)
    ~(all_net_proceeds_contributed_to_organization : bool)
    ~(substantially_all_work_performed_by_volunteers : bool)
    ~(exempt_years_under_ii_or_iii_in_preceding_six_years : int)
    ~(all_compensation_described_in_872b3 : bool)
    ~(cumulative_exempt_years_under_ii_or_iii : int)
    ~(establishes_no_intent_to_permanently_reside : bool)
    ~(meets_requirements_of_subparagraph_d_ii : bool)
    () : bool =
  let base_exempt =
    is_exempt_individual
      is_foreign_government_related_individual
      is_teacher_or_trainee
      is_student
      is_professional_athlete
      is_temporarily_in_united_states_to_compete
      event_organized_primarily_to_benefit_501c3_exempt_org
      all_net_proceeds_contributed_to_organization
      substantially_all_work_performed_by_volunteers

    Teachers_trainees_students_limitation.teacher_or_trainee_limited

      cumulative_exempt_years_under_ii_or_iii
      establishes_no_intent_to_permanently_reside
      meets_requirements_of_subparagraph_d_ii
  in
  base_exempt && not teacher_trainee_barred && not student_barred

(* 7701(b)(2)(C): disregards nominal presence in the US for purposes of (A)(iii)/(B) where the individual has a closer connection to a foreign country, capped at 10 such days *)
let is_day_disregarded
    (has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country : date -> bool)
    (days_present_in_us : date list)
    (day : date)
  : bool =
  let closer_connection_days =
    List.sort compare (List.filter has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country days_present_in_us)
  in
  let disregarded_days = List.filteri (fun i _ -> i < 10) closer_connection_days in
  has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country day && List.mem day disregarded_days

(* 7701(b)(2)(A)(ii)-(iv): residency starting date, selected by which criterion establishes residency *)
let residency_starting_date
    ~is_lawful_permanent_resident:(is_lawful_permanent_resident : bool)
    ~meets_substantial_presence_test:(meets_substantial_presence_test : bool)
    ~makes_first_year_election:(makes_first_year_election : bool)
    ~first_presence_date_as_lpr:(first_presence_date_as_lpr : date option)
    ~first_presence_date:(first_presence_date : date option)
    ~election_effective_date:(election_effective_date : date option)
  : date =
  if makes_first_year_election then
    match election_effective_date with
    | Some d -> d
    | None -> failwith "missing election effective date"
  else if meets_substantial_presence_test then
    match first_presence_date with
    | Some d -> d
    | None -> failwith "missing first presence date"
  else if is_lawful_permanent_resident then
    match first_presence_date_as_lpr with
    | Some d -> d
    | None -> failwith "missing first presence date as lawful permanent resident"
  else
    failwith "no residency starting date criterion met"

(* 7701(b)(2)(A)(i): alien resident under paragraph (1)(A) treated resident only from residency starting date, if not resident preceding calendar year *)
let first_year_residency_start
    ~is_resident_under_1a:(is_resident_under_1a : bool)
    ~was_resident_preceding_year:(was_resident_preceding_year : bool)
    ~is_lawful_permanent_resident:(is_lawful_permanent_resident : bool)
    ~meets_substantial_presence_test:(meets_substantial_presence_test : bool)
    ~makes_first_year_election:(makes_first_year_election : bool)
    ~first_presence_date_as_lpr:(first_presence_date_as_lpr : date option)
    ~first_presence_date:(first_presence_date : date option)
    ~election_effective_date:(election_effective_date : date option)
  : date option =
  if is_resident_under_1a && not was_resident_preceding_year then
    Some (residency_starting_date
      ~is_lawful_permanent_resident
      ~meets_substantial_presence_test
      ~makes_first_year_election
      ~first_presence_date_as_lpr
      ~first_presence_date
      ~election_effective_date)
  else
    None

(* 7701(b)(9)(B): fiscal year taxpayer - resident treatment for portion of a non-calendar taxable year within the calendar year of residency *)
let is_resident_for_taxable_year_portion
    ~(is_resident_under_paragraph_1 : bool) (* (i): resident under paragraph (1) for the calendar year *)
    ~(taxable_year : taxable_year) (* individual's taxable year after application of subparagraph (A) *)
    ~(is_portion_within_calendar_year : bool) (* the portion of the taxable year at issue falls within that calendar year *)
    : bool =
  is_resident_under_paragraph_1
  && taxable_year <> Calendar_year_basis
  && is_portion_within_calendar_year

(* 7701(b)(1): alien individual residency status for title purposes (other than subtitle B) *)
module Alien_residency = struct
  (* 7701(b)(1)(A): resident alien - lawful permanent resident, substantial presence test, or first-year election *)
  let is_resident_alien
      ~(lawful_permanent_resident : bool)
      ~(meets_substantial_presence_test : bool)
      ~(makes_first_year_election : bool)
      : bool =
    lawful_permanent_resident ||
    meets_substantial_presence_test ||
    makes_first_year_election

  (* 7701(b)(1)(B): nonresident alien - alien individual neither a citizen nor a resident under (A) *)
  let is_nonresident_alien
      ~(is_citizen : bool)
      ~(lawful_permanent_resident : bool)
      ~(meets_substantial_presence_test : bool)
      ~(makes_first_year_election : bool)
      : bool =
    not is_citizen &&
    not (is_resident_alien ~lawful_permanent_resident ~meets_substantial_presence_test ~makes_first_year_election)
end

(* 7701(b)(4): first-year election - alien meeting (A)'s requirements may elect resident treatment for election_year, starting from earliest qualifying testing period; election made on return, gated by post-year SPT status and revocable only with Secretary consent *)
let first_year_election
    ~(is_resident_under_lawful_permanent_residence_or_substantial_presence_test_election_year : bool)
    ~(is_resident_under_paragraph_1a_preceding_election_year : bool)
    ~(is_resident_under_substantial_presence_test_following_election_year : bool)
    ~(consecutive_days_present_in_election_year : int)
    ~(testing_period_length : int)
    ~(days_present_in_testing_period : int)
    ~(earliest_qualifying_testing_period_start : date)
    ~(individual_elects : bool)
    ~(revoked_with_secretary_consent : bool) : date option =
  (* (A): conjunction of clauses (i)-(iv); presence counts here follow the rules of paragraph (3)(D)(i) per (D) *)
  let meets_requirements =
    meets_first_year_election_requirements
      ~is_resident_under_lawful_permanent_residence_or_substantial_presence_test_election_year
      ~is_resident_under_paragraph_1a_preceding_election_year
      ~is_resident_under_substantial_presence_test_following_election_year
      ~consecutive_days_present_in_election_year
      ~testing_period_length
      ~days_present_in_testing_period
  in
  (* (E): election valid only once (3) SPT is met for the year following election_year *)
  let election_timely =
    individual_elects && is_resident_under_substantial_presence_test_following_election_year
  in
  (* (F): election stays in effect unless revoked with Secretary's consent *)
  if meets_requirements && election_timely && not revoked_with_secretary_consent then
    (* (B),(C): resident of election_year starting the 1st day of earliest qualifying testing period *)
    Some earliest_qualifying_testing_period_start
  else None

module Taxable_year_rules = struct
  (* 7701(b)(9)(A): alien individual with no taxable year established for prior period treated as calendar year *)
  let default_taxable_year
      ~(established_taxable_year : taxable_year option) (* None if not established for any prior period *)
      : taxable_year =
    match established_taxable_year with
    | Some ty -> ty
    | None -> Calendar_year_basis

  (* 7701(b)(9)(B): fiscal year taxpayer - resident treatment for portion of a non-calendar taxable year within the calendar year of residency *)
  let is_resident_for_taxable_year_portion
      ~(is_resident_under_paragraph_1 : bool)
      ~(taxable_year : taxable_year)
      ~(is_portion_within_calendar_year : bool)
      : bool =
    is_resident_under_paragraph_1
    && taxable_year <> Calendar_year_basis
    && is_portion_within_calendar_year
end
